The specimen demonstrates a cribriform growth pattern. A cribriform pattern is present as a high-risk feature. Perineural invasion is not identified. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone at the apex left. There is no data regarding the number of cores or percentage involvement.

Summary trajectory: The single available biopsy timepoint shows Gleason 0+0 (ISUP GG 0) with a cribriform pattern.
